nodes.description: Owner address of the Owned contract; set to msg.sender in constructor and checked in onlyOwner.
Pending new owner address set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Public token symbol string set in constructor to 'lqdv'.
Public token name string set in constructor to 'liquidx'.
Public token decimals set in constructor to 8.
Total token supply; set in constructor to 30500000000000 and read by totalSupply().
Mapping of account address to token balance; mutated by transfer/transferFrom and constructor.
Nested allowance mapping owner => spender => amount; mutated by approve and approveAndCall.
Checked addition helper used by transfer/transferFrom; requires c >= a.
Checked subtraction helper; requires b <= a.
Checked multiplication helper; requires a == 0 || c / a == b.
Checked division helper; requires b > 0.
Sets owner = msg.sender, assigning initial contract ownership.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Requires msg.sender == newOwner then transfers ownership and clears newOwner.
Initializes symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and pre-mints the whole supply to a fixed address.
Constant function returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Constant function returning balances[tokenOwner].
Moves tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to', decrementing the caller allowance via safeSub.
Constant function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance then executes receiveApproval on the spender contract, an arbitrary external call.
Payable fallback function that always reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
onlyOwner function that calls transfer on an arbitrary token contract address.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance ownership and allowance ownership.
Addition c = a + b guarded by require(c >= a); overflow risk class arithmetic.
Subtraction c = a - b guarded by require(b <= a); underflow risk class arithmetic.
Multiplication c = a * b guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b); overflow risk class arithmetic.
Division c = a / b guarded by require(b > 0); division-by-zero risk class arithmetic.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) to an attacker-controlled address, reentrancy risk.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary contract, reentrancy risk.

edges.reason: Recipient parameter to is used as the destination of balances update in transfer.
tokens parameter determines the debited/credited amount in transfer.
spender parameter indexes allowed mapping in approve.
tokens parameter is the allowance value written in approve.
from parameter is debited in transferFrom.
to parameter is credited in transferFrom.
tokens parameter controls both balance and allowance subtraction in transferFrom.
tokenOwner parameter indexes balances in balanceOf.
tokenOwner indexes the outer allowance mapping.
spender indexes the inner allowance mapping.
spender is both the allowance grantee and the external call target in approveAndCall.
tokens sets the allowance and is forwarded to receiveApproval.
data is caller-controlled calldata forwarded to receiveApproval.
tokenAddress selects the external contract called by transferAnyERC20Token.
tokens is the amount forwarded to the external token transfer.
_newOwner parameter is stored into newOwner by transferOwnership.
safeAdd operand a feeds the addition.
safeAdd operand b feeds the addition.
safeSub operand a feeds the subtraction.
safeSub operand b feeds the subtraction.
safeMul operand a feeds the multiplication.
safeMul operand b feeds the multiplication.
safeDiv numerator a feeds the division.
safeDiv denominator b feeds the division and the b > 0 guard.
safeAdd operand a flows into the addition expression, classed as arithmetic.
safeAdd operand b flows into the addition expression, classed as arithmetic.
safeSub operand a flows into the subtraction expression.
safeSub operand b flows into the subtraction expression.
safeMul operand a flows into the multiplication expression.
safeMul operand b flows into the multiplication expression.
safeDiv numerator flows into the division expression.
safeDiv denominator flows into the division expression.
spender parameter is the target address of the external receiveApproval call.
tokens parameter is passed into the external receiveApproval call.
data parameter is passed into the external receiveApproval call.
tokenAddress parameter is the target of the external token transfer call.
tokens parameter is forwarded into the external token transfer call.
safeAdd executes the guarded addition operation.
safeSub executes the guarded subtraction operation.
safeMul executes the guarded multiplication operation.
safeDiv executes the guarded division operation.
approveAndCall performs the external receiveApproval call after writing the allowance.
transferAnyERC20Token performs the external ERC20 transfer call.
Owned constructor assigns msg.sender as owner, an authorization-sensitive assignment.
transferOwnership is protected by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
transfer uses msg.sender as the debited account.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender key for the allowance subtraction.
approveAndCall uses msg.sender as allowance owner and forwards it to receiveApproval.
transfer invokes safeSub on the sender balance.
transfer invokes safeAdd on the recipient balance.
transferFrom invokes safeSub for the from balance and the allowance.
transferFrom invokes safeAdd for the recipient balance.
transfer reads and writes balances mapping.
transferFrom mutates balances for from and to.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
liquidx constructor sets _totalSupply.
liquidx constructor pre-mints balances at a fixed address.
liquidx constructor sets symbol.
liquidx constructor sets name.
liquidx constructor sets decimals.
Owned constructor writes owner = msg.sender, establishing privileged access.
transferOwnership writes the pending owner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with newOwner after the msg.sender check.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0).
transferAnyERC20Token is onlyOwner and always sends swept tokens to owner.
Attacker-controlled spender contract can re-enter token functions such as transfer during the receiveApproval callback.
Attacker-controlled spender contract can re-enter transferFrom during the receiveApproval callback.
Arbitrary tokenAddress contract can re-enter token functions during the external transfer call.
